source_name: ЦРРСМ — Основен профил на регистриран субјект (basic company profile search)
why_relevant: Free public lookup of registration number (ЕМБС), tax number (ЕДБ), name, seat, legal form, size category, founding date and status (active / bankruptcy / liquidation) for any registered entity. This is the base identity resolver for every MK bank, savings house, payment institution and payments vendor, and the anchor key (ЕМБС) that links all other statutory filings.

source_name: ЦРРСМ — Објави на уписи за субјекти (publication feed of register entries / corporate change notices)
why_relevant: Statutory publication stream of executed registrations and changes in the Trade Register, Register of Other Legal Entities and Register of Disqualified Entities. This is the highest-tempo early-warning channel for MK banking/payments: capital increases, changes of management and supervisory boards, changes of activity codes, mergers, new payment-services companies, branch openings, liquidations. Available for unlisted entities that never issue a press release.

source_name: ЦРРСМ — Регистар на годишни сметки / електронска достава на годишна сметка (e-submit)
why_relevant: The statutory Register of Annual Accounts and its electronic submission front-end. All legal entities, listed or not, must file balance sheet and income statement schemes here; medium and large entities file electronically and attach audit reports. This is the single channel that yields comparable financials for unlisted savings houses, payment institutions, processors and IT/POS vendors serving MK banks.

source_name: ЦРРСМ — Регистар на вистински сопственици (Register of Beneficial Owners)
why_relevant: Statutory UBO register run by ЦРРСМ under the AML/CFT law in cooperation with the Financial Intelligence Unit (Управа за финансиско разузнавање), built with GIZ support. Reveals the natural persons behind MK payment-services companies, e-money issuers, exchange offices and fintech vendors — the ownership layer that never appears in marketing material and that matters for partner due diligence and for spotting the same owners behind multiple payments entities.

source_name: ЦРРСМ — Дистрибутивен систем (Distributive System, bulk/contracted data distribution)
why_relevant: The registrar's contracted bulk-data channel: signed agreement plus prepaid balance gives programmatic/repeat access to register data (entity profiles, annual accounts, pledges, publications). This is the compliant route to systematic, licensable collection of MK banking and payments entity data instead of scraping the public pages, and it is the only route that clears the non-commercial-use restriction on the free listings.

source_name: ЦРРСМ — Тарифа (fee schedule for register data and certificates)
why_relevant: Prices the whole statutory-filing channel: cost per entity profile, per annual account, per historical file inspection, per bulk feed. Needed to budget and design the MK collection plan, and it implicitly enumerates which data products actually exist.

source_name: ЦРРСМ — Отворени податоци / Статистички билтен (open data and statistical bulletin)
why_relevant: Registrar-published statistics derived from the filings: entity counts and new registrations by activity code (NKD), region, legal form and size. Gives the population denominator for the MK payments and financial-services sector — how many payment-services companies, exchange offices, IT/fintech entities exist and how fast the cohort grows — without needing per-entity purchases.

source_name: ЦРРСМ — Увид во досие од Трговски регистар и Регистар на други правни лица (file inspection / scanned founding and change documents)
why_relevant: Access to the scanned underlying documents of an entity's registry file: articles of association, shareholder decisions, capital changes, board appointments, merger and status-change acts. For MK banks and payment institutions this is the deepest primary-document layer available outside the supervisor, and it is where the substance behind a one-line publication notice sits.

source_name: ЦРРСМ — Потврда за тековна состојба (current-status certificate)
why_relevant: Authoritative extract of an entity's current registered data: managers and their powers of representation, founders/shareholders, registered activities, capital. The standard evidence document for confirming who legally signs for an MK bank, savings house or payment institution, and for verifying claimed activity licences.

source_name: ЦРРСМ — Проверка и резервација на име на правен субјект (name check / reservation)
why_relevant: A leading indicator: name checks and reservations precede incorporation. Screening reserved names containing payments-sector markers (плаќања, pay, финтек, процесинг, е-пари) can surface entrants weeks before they appear in the Trade Register. Also a cheap way to test whether a rumoured entity name already exists.

source_name: ЦРРСМ — Регистрација на директни инвестиции (Register of Direct Investments)
why_relevant: Statutory registration channel for foreign direct investment in MK legal entities. Relevant because foreign parent banks, payment groups and PE owners recapitalising or acquiring MK banking/payments entities must register the investment — a filing trail for ownership changes that may not be announced.

source_name: ЦРРСМ — Регистар на залог (Register of Pledges) and Регистар на дисквалификувани лица (Register of Disqualified Persons)
why_relevant: Two secondary statutory registers with real payments-sector value: pledges reveal which MK banks hold security over which corporates and which payments vendors have pledged assets (a distress and financing signal); disqualified persons flags managers barred from running companies — a due-diligence screen for prospective fintech partners and agents.

source_name: BIFIDEX — Western Balkans regional business & financial registry portal (co-founded by ЦРРСМ)
why_relevant: Official cross-border re-publication of MK Central Registry data alongside Serbia, Albania, Montenegro and Republika Srpska: statutory data, ownership, governance and financial reports for ~1.5m entities, with comparison and industry-screening tools. Co-created by ЦРРСМ and the Serbian Business Registers Agency with EBRD funding, so it carries registrar authority while being far easier to query at scale than crm.com.mk — and it enables regional benchmarking of MK banks and payments vendors against peers.

source_name: CompanyData.com — Macedonia legal-entity database (licensed CRM-derived dataset)
why_relevant: Commercial redistribution of Central Registry entity data (~10.7k legal entities advertised, 50+ fields, enriched with financials and ownership). Useful as a bulk shortcut to build the initial population list of MK financial-services and payments entities by activity code before spending on official extracts; must be treated as second-hand and re-verified against ЦРРСМ.

source_name: Schmidt & Schmidt / Creditreform / Registrall — commercial retrieval of MK commercial-register extracts and accounting statements
why_relevant: Agency channel for obtaining certified MK register extracts and filed annual accounts without a local presence or a Macedonian digital certificate, including apostilled and translated copies. Practical fallback when ЦРРСМ's own paid services are hard to transact with from abroad; the pages also document precisely which MK filings are obtainable (extracts, annual accounts, pledges, leasing, real-estate investments).

source_name: ЈП Службен весник на РСМ (Official Gazette) — statutory publication archive
why_relevant: The statutory publication of record adjacent to the registrar: the Law on the Central Registry, the Companies Act, accounting and audit rules, AML/UBO rules, and National Bank decisions and licences affecting banks and payment institutions are all promulgated here. It is the authoritative archive for the legal framework that governs what MK entities must file and when, and it carries some licensing/status acts that never surface on the registrar's own site.

source_name: Управа за финансиско разузнавање (Financial Intelligence Office) — UBO register announcements and AML guidance
why_relevant: Co-owner of the beneficial-ownership regime with ЦРРСМ. Publishes when the UBO register went live, who must register, enforcement and guidance — the interpretive layer needed to know how complete and how current the UBO data on payment-services companies actually is, and which obliged-entity categories (including payment institutions and exchange offices) are in scope.

source_name: ЦРРСМ — Проекти / Вести (institutional projects and news feed)
why_relevant: The registrar's own project and news stream announced the UBO register launch, its upgrades, BIFIDEX, the population-register integration and filing-deadline extensions. It is the leading indicator of new data channels and of changes to filing rules — i.e. it tells the collector when a source is about to appear, move or change shape.

source_name: Институт на овластени ревизори / сметководители — professional-body materials on the Register of Annual Accounts
why_relevant: Practitioner training material authored with ЦРРСМ describing exactly how the Register of Annual Accounts works: which schemes are filed, by whom, in what format, what audit attachments are required and what the retrieval products are. This is the cheapest way to learn the internal structure of the filings before designing extraction, and it names the field vocabulary used in MK balance-sheet schemes.

source_name: ЦРРСМ — Обрасци и формулари (forms and templates)
why_relevant: The blank statutory forms define the exact field set of every filing — annual-account schemes, registration applications, UBO forms. Knowing the schema in advance is what makes downstream parsing of purchased filings deterministic rather than exploratory.

source_name: Open Government Partnership — commitment MK0122 'Public Access to the Central Register'
why_relevant: Independent, dated documentation of what the Central Registry committed to open up, what actually shipped and what stalled. The best external evidence on how open MK registry data really is — directly informing whether free public access or the paid Distributive System is the realistic collection route, and where advocacy/FOI pressure has already been tried.

source_name: АСЈИ / aspi.mk — Central Registry as a holder of public information (FOI route)
why_relevant: Lists ЦРРСМ as an information holder under the freedom-of-information law, with its designated officers. This is the formal escalation path when a needed aggregate (e.g. counts or lists of registered payment-services companies by activity code) is not offered as a product — a legal request route rather than a purchase.

source_name: Клириншка куќа КИБС АД Скопје — Статистика (KIBS clearing statistics)
why_relevant: KIBS is the operator of the national small-value interbank payment (clearing) system; its statistics page publishes participant lists, annual transaction counts, active account counts in the ERTC/single register of accounts, net/gross coverage and average transaction values — the load-bearing volume series for MK retail interbank payments.

source_name: КИБС — Вести и промоции (KIBS news / announcements)
why_relevant: Primary channel for KIBS service launches, tariff changes, participant onboarding and infrastructure changes (e.g. instant-payment and e-invoice/trust-service developments). Press-release stream for the clearing layer.

source_name: KIBSTrust (КИБС дигитални доверливи услуги / certification authority)
why_relevant: KIBS' digital-trust arm (first registered certificate issuer in MK, active since 2002). Relevant to e-signature/e-identity rails underpinning digital banking and payment onboarding; publishes service and compliance announcements.

source_name: CaSys MEDIA / blog (press releases)
why_relevant: CaSys' own press-release feed — partnership announcements (e.g. reported partnership with the Macedonian Banking Association), new payment products, milestones. Earliest signal of processing-side change.

source_name: НБРМ — Македонски Интербанкарски Платен Систем (MIPS) system page
why_relevant: MIPS is the central-bank-operated RTGS (live since 30 July 2001). The page documents participants — banks, Treasury/Ministry of Finance, KIBS, Central Securities Depository, CaSys, Mastercard, brokerages — and operating hours. Authoritative description of the settlement layer and of which schemes settle domestically.
